# pantechdynamics_region (Data Source)

Looks up one region by code. Use it to fail early on a wrong region, and to read where each kind of instance lands there and whether your account can create one now. Use pantechdynamics_regions to list them all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look one region up by code, and see where each kind of instance lands there.
data "pantechdynamics_region" "abuja" {
  code = "af-abj"
}

output "abuja_placements" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_region.abuja.placements
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Code of the region to look up, for example "af-abj". It must match exactly. The lookup fails if no region has it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The region code. Present because every data source needs an id.
- `name` (String) Display name of the region.
- `placements` (Attributes List) Where each kind of instance lands in this region. A kind the region does not offer is absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placements))

<a id="nestedatt--placements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placements`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether your account can create an instance of this kind here now.
- `kind` (String) "standard" is a VPS with a public IP on the shared network. "vpc" is a VM in a customer VPC.
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Why it is unavailable, or null when available.
- `zone` (String) Zone where a new instance of this kind lands. Check an image's zones against it.
